description: Registry of all Kinetic cohort profiles across strategic tiers. Each entry summarizes a cohort profile and references its detailed schema file. This is the portfolio-level view — the fund manager's dashboard for fleet intelligence allocation.

tier_1.label: Core Revenue + Core Intelligence
tier_1.description: Primary acquisition targets. These cohorts generate the highest-value intelligence signal due to architectural homogeneity (modern JS stacks) and commercial density. Each profile represents a well-defined market with clear territorial boundaries and high willingness-to-pay for SEO intelligence.

tier_2.label: Strategic Intelligence
tier_2.description: Secondary acquisition targets that expand E.V.O.'s architectural and behavioral pattern coverage. These cohorts introduce platform diversity (WordPress, Shopify-native, static generators, bespoke enterprise) that deepens the fleet's diagnostic range and makes cross-cohort intelligence transfer more robust.

_portfolio_summary.total_seats_at_full_allocation: 136 × N geographic markets = total addressable fleet size

profiles.label: SaaS Marketing Sites
profiles.intelligence_value: Highest density of content-driven organic strategies. Protocol outcome data transfers broadly across SaaS verticals due to shared content architecture patterns.

profiles.label: Headless E-commerce
profiles.intelligence_value: Commerce-specific SEO patterns — product schema, faceted navigation, category architecture — that don't exist in content-only sites. Critical for broadening E.V.O.'s technical diagnostic range.

profiles.label: Developer Tools / API Companies
profiles.intelligence_value: Documentation-driven SEO is a unique pattern — technical content, versioned docs, API references, changelog indexing. Intelligence here is non-transferable from other cohorts, making dedicated fleet coverage essential.

profiles.label: Tech Startups (General)
profiles.intelligence_value: Early-stage SEO patterns — foundation building, initial content strategy, first backlink acquisition. Critical for understanding the zero-to-one trajectory that mature cohorts have already completed.

profiles.label: Agencies Building on Modern Stacks
profiles.intelligence_value: Agency sites are portfolio-driven — case studies, vertical landing pages, thought leadership. Their SEO patterns reflect trust-building through demonstrated expertise, a distinct pattern from product-led or content-led growth.

profiles.label: Headless WordPress Properties
profiles.intelligence_value: WordPress-to-headless migration patterns are a unique diagnostic signal. E.V.O. learns the specific failure modes of decoupled WordPress — REST API pagination, preview routing, legacy URL preservation — that pure headless sites never encounter.

profiles.label: Shopify Hydrogen Stores
profiles.intelligence_value: Platform-constrained SEO patterns. Hydrogen's Remix-based architecture introduces specific rendering, routing, and caching behaviors that affect indexation. Intelligence here deepens E.V.O.'s platform-specific diagnostic capabilities.

profiles.label: Static Site Generators
profiles.intelligence_value: Build-time SEO is fundamentally different from runtime SEO. No server-side rendering, no dynamic content, no JavaScript hydration. Intelligence here teaches E.V.O. the purest form of content-driven organic performance — stripped of all technical confounders.

profiles.label: Custom Enterprise Platforms
profiles.intelligence_value: Enterprise-scale SEO operates under fundamentally different constraints — crawl budget engineering, index management at 100K+ pages, organizational SEO governance. Intelligence here is rare and high-value because few diagnostic engines have fleet-level exposure to enterprise patterns.
